title: A TRADE OFFER STAYS ON SCREEN WHILE IT IS OPEN
why: A trade offer came once in the message feed and faded, so a player on a controller who missed it never knew an item was waiting for him. While an offer to you is open, a line under the boss bar now names who offers what, says T or Y takes it and counts the seconds left; while your own offer is open, it says who it waits on. Drawing only.
now: Trading: an open offer now stays on screen with who offers what, T or Y to take it and the seconds left, and the giver sees who it is waiting on.
